explanation: I found no Mathlib lemma stating this. `ψ` and `ΨSq` are used only in the two division-polynomial files under `Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/EllipticCurve/DivisionPolynomial/` (`Basic.lean` and `Degree.lean`). A search for `evalEval` and `Equation` in that directory found nothing. In `Basic.lean`, the word `eval` appears only once, in a docstring. Mathlib does prove `Affine.CoordinateRing.mk_ψ` and `Affine.CoordinateRing.mk_Ψ_sq`, which give the same identity in the coordinate ring. The library's proof uses both lemmas, then pulls the identity back to the polynomials (`AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_mk`) and evaluates at the point (x, y). That takes several steps, more than the one or two short lines allowed for a special case. So Mathlib has the ingredients but no single lemma that evaluates `ψ n` at a point on the curve.
